links.outcome: Patient satisfaction with nurse-LLM collaboration vs nurse alone in randomized trial
links.effect: Satisfaction 3.91 ± 0.90 vs 3.39 ± 1.15 in nurse group (P < 0.001); repeated Q&R 3.2% vs 14.4%; negative emotions 2.4% vs 7.8%.
links.quote: In a single-center randomized controlled trial involving 2,164 participants, the primary endpoint indicated that the nurse-SSPEC collaboration model received higher satisfaction feedback from patients (3.91 ± 0.90 versus 3.39 ± 1.15 in the nurse group, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Nurse-LLM collaboration model in which nurses oversee uncertainties in patient-facing reception chatbot
Site-specific prompt engineering for LLM reception chatbot built from real-world conversation audio corpus

screen.reason: The study evaluates a randomized controlled trial of an LLM deployed in an outpatient reception setting via a human-in-the-loop nurse-AI collaboration model compared to standard nurse-led reception.
